edges.label: Navy F/A-18F pilot turned first active-duty-era witness before Congress
edges.note: In his own words: 'My name is Ryan "FOBS" Graves and I am a former F-18 pilot with over a decade of service in the U.S. Navy, including two deployments in Operation Enduring Freedom and Operation Inherent Resolve.' He joined the Navy in 2009, describes the encounters in the W-72 warning area, and states 'I founded Americans for Safe Aerospace to create a center of support, research, and public education for aircrew impacted by UAP encounters', reporting nearly 5,000 members and more than 30 witnesses working with the organisation.

edges.label: East Coast UAP encounters reported by Roosevelt-deployed Navy aircrew
edges.note: Two of the three videos the Department released in April 2020 are dated January 2015, and Graves's testimony places his squadron's encounters in the W-72 warning area off the east coast, beginning more than a decade before he testified: 'my squadron began witnessing advanced UAP demonstrating complex maneuvers on a regular basis'. Tier 2 because neither primary document names the USS Theodore Roosevelt. The carrier association is well attested elsewhere; it is not in the two documents cited here.

title: Ryan Graves / Americans for Safe Aerospace written testimony, House Oversight subcommittee hearing, July 26, 2023
